item.title: 5-Year-Old Liam Conejo Ramos And Father Return To Minnesota From ICE Facility In Texas
item.description: By JACK DURA Associated Press Five-year-old Liam Conejo Ramos and his father, who were detained by immigration officers in Minnesota and held at an ICE facility in Texas, have been released following a judge’s order. They have returned to Minnesota, according to Texas Rep. Joaquin Castro. The boy and his dad, Adrian Conejo Arias, who is originally from Ecuador, were detained in a Minneapolis suburb on Jan. 20. item.title: Police Officer Killed, Another Critically Wounded In Shooting At Hotel
item.description: LAWRENCEVILLE, Ga. (AP) — A police officer was killed and another was critically wounded Sunday in a shootout at a hotel in suburban Atlanta. Gwinnett County police said in a statement that gunfire broke out early Sunday after two officers were dispatched on a call reporting fraud at the address of a hotel near Stone Mountain, about 25 miles (40 kilometers) northeast of Atlanta. item.title: Abbott Calls For Investigation
item.description: Texas Governor Greg Abbott says he’s directed the state’s Education Commissioner to investigate student protests at Austin ISD. item.title: Three Dead, One Injured In Fire
item.description: Three people are dead and another is injured after a fire broke out a house in Weatherford early Saturday morning. Crews were called to the home on Stoneridge Trail and found visible heavy fire and smoke conditions upon arrival. One person was taken to a hospital, while three people were found dead. Parker County and Tarrant County Task Force Fire Marshals are looking into what caused the blaze.
